# Phase One — Chesed: UI/API Possibility Map

The Awtsmoos renews every screen from nothing, yet no screen should pretend to own its neighbor's skin;
Awtsmoos.com may glow with futuristic motion only when each local vessel knows exactly where it must begin.

## Ideal product surface
- Every route has exactly one explicit style authority root.
- Shared design systems are opt-in, never implicit global resets.
- Every interactive element has complete hover-capable, active, focus-visible, disabled, busy, invalid, selected/current/expanded states as applicable.
- Advanced tools retract into native or accessible disclosures instead of crowding first paint.
- Mobile is the base layout; wide screens progressively reveal secondary navigation and inspectors.
- Every panel owns a local z-index scale and clipping/overflow policy.
- Motion communicates hierarchy, success, disclosure, loading, and focus without decorative noise.
- Reduced-motion and forced-colors preserve the whole workflow, not merely stop animations.
- Form autofill looks intentional instead of browser-injected.
- Empty/loading/error/authenticated/signed-out states remain visually distinct.
- Route families may share tokens, but not unscoped selectors.
- Page scripts use abortable lifecycle controllers and explicit state machines instead of anonymous listener accumulation.
- Network/API access flows through request/result objects with normalized loading/error/auth/retry semantics.
- Data descriptors feed renderers; DOM code should not own application truth.
- JSDoc stays expansive and descriptive; file budgets are solved with more modules.

## Immediate reference family
Authentication is the first reference because it is small, public, mobile-sensitive, security-adjacent, and currently demonstrates real selector leakage. Once its contract is green, the same sovereignty tests can be generalized to other style families.

## NEXT_ACTION
Complete the auth family as the first provably root-scoped design-system slice.
